candidateEstimate.limits: Estimates exclude JS object/string/map overhead, transient JSON parsing/hash copies, browser/worker runtime and future notice corrections. gzip measures local compression only, not server transfer encoding. Candidate stages have not passed audio checks.
candidateEstimate.method: Candidate metadata text measured; coverage/audio-hash/row overhead and build scale from active export; manifest/pointer held constant; attribution uses candidate notices with baseline metadata header. Vector size is exact conditional on count and unchanged dimension. No vectors or future coverage are generated.
